subject: Post-discovery: Architecture review & infra handoff for Sundial

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-discovery: Architecture review & infra handoff for Sundial

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday. Based on what we covered, the best next step is a focused architecture/ops review where our infra engineers walk through:
- serving runtime and model variant options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- latency & KV cache behavior for your 1–2s tail SLOs
- networking / VPC connectivity patterns and required firewall rules
- data isolation and retention concerns for clinical PII

Can we lock a 60‑minute slot next week? My team can cover the first 40 minutes of architecture + topology choices and leave 20 minutes for your platform questions and any compliance asks. Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Jul 16, 11:00–12:00 PDT
- Wed Jul 17, 08:00–09:00 PDT
- Thu Jul 18, 14:00–15:00 PDT

If none of those work, please suggest 2–3 times that suit your platform lead and infra engineer. We’ll include Ben (solutions lead) and Priyom (integration). I’ve attached a short pre-read (sundial-arch-prelim.pdf) to set context.

Agenda draft attached in the doc link below.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: sundial-arch-prelim.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b-example-pre-read
